name: doge-sol-trend-shadow
selection_note: User-requested prospective volatility adaptation. DOGE25 was not selected on prior holdout returns; prior DOGE50/SOL50 diagnostic failed training short-profit eligibility. No retrospective performance is assigned to this variant.
comparison: Current max-leverage long-only default remains untouched; record mark-to-market P&L, funding, fees, observed drawdown and distinct filled TP action deltas from first fresh baseline. Different leverage and trend settings mean this is not an isolated attribution experiment.
funding: Native published funding at actual timestamps, idempotently applied to historical holdings, including late publications.
execution: Actual sorted native depth with IOC partial fills, integer contracts, 4bps taker fee and 30bps total per-side cost cap; current native side-specific margin estimates.
guard: Original 35% initial-equity guard blocks all strategy orders including exits; no flatten or resume. Funding and liquidation continue.
startup: Start flat; skip carried signals and wait for fresh breakout onset.
change_policy: Immutable source-pinned profile and image. Any parameter change starts a newly identified account; never retune the running shadow.
evaluation: Report cumulative and common-start metrics. Rate normalization only after one observed day. No automatic promotion; review after at least 90 calendar days and 20 completed natural episodes; extend if sample insufficient. Review drawdowns, guard/liquidations, funding coverage, data blocks, spread/fill rejection and TP profitability before any decision.
